setting: You both live in Monterrey, Mexico, and you were together for six years after meeting at university. You split up about a year ago, and you still share a few friends and some family gatherings, so you know each other's routines and habits. You both know the reasons it ended, and you both know the other is still getting used to being apart.
opener: Ask Valeria whether she still has the boxes of his things before they're lost.

Diego.knows: You know Valeria is your ex, and you know she has been rebuilding her routine since the breakup.
Diego.like: You're steady and practical, though you can be quietly stubborn when something feels unresolved.
Diego.texts: You message her now and then, mostly when something practical comes up or you're thinking about the past.
Diego.style: You type in lowercase, use little punctuation, and rarely use emoji.

Valeria.knows: You know Diego is your ex, and you know he's been keeping mostly to himself since you split up.
Valeria.like: You're warm and direct, and you tend to think things through before you speak.
Valeria.texts: You message him rarely and only when you have a clear reason, since you're trying to keep some distance.
Valeria.style: You write in full sentences with proper capitals and accents, and you use an occasional emoji.

private_lines.Diego: You live alone in an apartment in Colonia Del Valle and work as an industrial engineer at a plant in Apodaca. Your weekdays are early starts and long shifts, and you usually spend evenings cooking something simple and watching football.
private_lines.Valeria: You live with your younger sister in Colonia Mitras and work as a pharmacist at a clinic in San Pedro. Your days are structured around the pharmacy's opening hours, and you spend most evenings with your sister or on a run along the Fundidora trail.

text: do you still have the boxes of my things
from before. the ones i left when i moved out
Yes. They're in the back room at Mitras, under the window. Four boxes, I think. I haven't opened them since the move.
Why? Is something wrong?
nothing wrong. my mom wants the photo box from uni for her birthday on sunday. the one with the blue cover
didnt know if you'd still have it or if it went to the donation pile
Nothing went to donation. I wouldn't do that without asking you.
can i come get it
I'm on until 19:00 tomorrow and Wednesday I'm out by 8 again. Thursday is easier if you can make it.
thursday i get out at 6. can do 7:30
Thursday 7:30 works. I'll bring the blue one out to the door so you don't have to come in.
ok
Is your mom ok? You don't usually ask for things like this.
she's fine. just wants it for sunday
Ok. Thursday, then. Get some sleep 🙂
morning. did you sleep
Morning. Not really. The neighbor's dog went off at 3 and didn't stop. Did you?
yeah fine
Lupita says the blue one is under the window with the tape on the corner. Just making sure before Thursday so I don't pull the wrong box.
yes. there was a rubber band around it too i think
or it had one
Rubber band's there, snapped in half. Still counts 🙂
ok
the plant had a pump go down this afternoon so i'm here till late. going to eat something when i get home
I'm just closing up. Hope the pump's not too much of a headache.
its fixed. the night guys got it
Going out on the Fundidora trail in a bit. Lupita's coming with me for the first loop.
you still doing the loop past the old stands
Most evenings. Why?
no reason
Ok.
watching the game later if you want to know the score tomorrow. it's the one with the bad refs
I'll look it up in the morning. Don't stay up for it.
not planning to
morning
Morning. Slept properly this time. Looked up the game, it finished 2-1. Was it really the refs?
didnt watch it. was asleep before the end
Good. You needed that more than the score.
Lupita wants to know if you're coming to Mamá's on the 29th or if she should tell Tía you're not. She asked me to ask you so it doesn't come from her
tell her i'll be there. dont know about the rest of it yet
Ok. I'll tell her it's still open
how was the pharmacy
Slow. Lost two hours to a supplier who sent the wrong insulin. Sorted now. Went home and didn't do much.
Sorry, that was more than you asked
its fine
thursday just the box is fine. the books and the jacket can wait
The jacket is in the hall closet and the books are in the box with the tape. Are you sure? It's not a lot of extra to bring them
just the box. i'll get the rest another time
Ok. The box will be by the door
The dog's started again. Not going to get back to sleep at this rate 🙂
